text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф might have forfeited the
Triple
Crown, but she can still win
something just as
valuable: the shield of
the spring Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her spirits are high as she looks to her
next race,
but they turn to concern when
she sees Air
Groove, who seems
exhausted.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Realizing that she is the reason Air
Groove has
been running herself ragged,
Симболи Рудольф
resolves not to skimp on
her presidential duties.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As the year comes to an end, it seems
that the
pair's desire to lighten one
another's burdens is
preventing them
from seeing eye to eye.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
